messages:
anya: quick heads-up — onboarding orca-mini-1.3b-quant hit a config lint failure when pushing to assets-gate. can someone look?

sam: on it. summary?

anya: manifest points at gs://models/team/orca-mini-1.3b/weights.tar (expected) but config.json has quant_profile: "int8-zz" which our schema doesn't know. lint output attached.

config-lint-bot: schema validation error:
```
ERROR config.json: unknown field "quant_profile" at /model/config.json
ERROR config.json: pad_id (256) conflicts with tokenizer.pad_id (0)
```

pete: wait pad_id mismatch too? that's new — who changed tokenizer?

anya: tokenizer in the artifact has pad_id: 0, but the ingest manifest auto-added pad_id: 256 when converting to quant weights archive. suspect the quant step tool sets a default.

zhu: likely quantizer default — we changed default pad_id to 256 in qtool v0.9.1 to avoid reserved token collision. forgot to update schema allowed values.

sam: easy two paths — (1) update config.json to include quant_profile mapping and add pad_id translation in the ingest hook, or (2) update the schema to accept quant_profile and add a migration that warns and normalizes pad_id.

anya: prefer schema change + migration so older manifests don't fail CI. can we add optional field: "quant_profile" enum ["int8-zz", "int8-ssr", "fp16"] with a normalization step?

pete: agree. but need to be careful: runtime needs to know kernel selection for int8-zz vs int8-ssr. add a compatibility table in the schema docs.

zhu: I'll open a quick PR that: adds quant_profile to model/config.schema.json, implements migration in ingest-service to map pad_id 256 -> tokenizer.pad_id when present, and adds unit test. targeting e2e pipeline owner review.

config-lint-bot: created issue #482: schema: allow quant_profile + pad_id migration (blocked by review).

sam: pinging @pete and @anya for review when PR is ready. CI will run the config-lint job and the serve-smoke tests.

ci-bot: CI queued: config-lint (linux), serve-smoke (gpu), unit (python).

anya: quick note for owners — if PR touches ingest-service, flakiness on serve-smoke can happen; recommend manual smoke on a dev-dedicated cluster after merge.

pete: noted. @zhu please add a short runbook entry in the PR description that lists manual smoke steps and expected logs (KV cache warm, no pad-id warnings).

zhu: will do. aiming to have PR by EOD PST.

sam: thanks — after merge i'll re-run the onboarding job for orca-mini-1.3b-quant and report back here. :thumbsup:

anya: awesome. if anything blocks, @anya will escalate to infra oncall.

pete: also, add a tiny eval prompt set to catch token off-by-one in our quality gates so we don't regress.

sam: added to the checklist.

anya: last: note to docs — add quant_profile description in model onboarding guide (assets team).

zhu: done in PR checklist.

sam: cool, thanks everyone.

anya: thanks — closing this async thread once PR is merged and onboarding succeeds.
